Thanks — aiming to keep this light so procurement can slot the PO without legal friction.

Hi Claire (and Soojin),

Thanks — this is all straightforward and aligns with our standard PO flow. To answer your questions:

1) PO + invoice routing: Yes, once we have a signed SOW and your PO number we will issue invoices that include your PO#. Please send PO to billings@clearstream-analytics.com and copy finance@redwood.ai so our AP team can reconcile.

2) Marketplace vs direct invoicing: AWS Marketplace invoicing is handled by the marketplace (AWS) and their billing entity will appear on invoices; Redwood cannot issue a separate direct invoice under a Marketplace subscription. That means net terms and remittance instructions are controlled by the marketplace flow — typically up-front or net-0 depending on the marketplace. For a clean PO-first approach with Net 30, direct invoicing is the better path.

Invoice matrix (minimum required fields) — please include these on the PO or provide them to us so we can mirror them on our invoice: 
- PO number (required)
- Billing/legal name and remit-to address
- AP contact email + preferred invoice format (PDF / CSV)
- Tax ID / VAT ID (if applicable)
- SOW reference (SOW #RW-3432)
- Currency (USD) and GL code if you want line-level mapping

I attached a filled example of the invoice matrix we typically send to customers. If you’d like, we can pre-fill it using your PO template once you send the PO.

Next operational step from Redwood: once we receive the PO we’ll return a redlined invoice sample and confirm the first invoice date (typically first month after activation). 

If procurement wants a short (15 min) handshake with our finance/AP team to validate format, I can set that up tomorrow.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
